concerns.text: FR-007 mandates 'Permutation Importance testing with 1,000 permutations' to determine statistical significance. Task T033c implements 'SHAP Bootstrapping' (resampling rows) and defines significance via 95% CIs of SHAP values. There is no task explicitly implementing the required Permutation Importance test (shuffling feature columns) as specified in FR-007 and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 2.

SC-001 defines success as R² ≥ 0.65 OR strictly greater than a dummy regressor baseline. Tasks T027b and T027d implement logic requiring BOTH conditions (R² > Dummy AND R² ≥ 0.65) to pass. This contradicts the spec's 'OR' logic, potentially causing the project to fail a success criterion even if one valid path is met. No task exists to implement the correct 'OR' logic.

FR-003 requires calculating Volumetric Energy Density (Ev) if raw parameters exist, OR using the provided column if available. Task T016b unconditionally creates two distinct subsets (X_raw and X_derived) and saves both. If the source dataset only provides Ev (no raw params), X_raw cannot be constructed; if it only provides raw params, X_derived is synthetic. The task lacks the conditional logic required by FR-003 to handle data availability scenarios.

US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires reporting the relative importance of the derived feature (Ev) alongside raw parameters to validate physical intuition. While T034b compares feature importance, it does not explicitly mandate the specific output format or logic to 'validate physical intuition' as a distinct deliverable required by the acceptance scenario, relying instead on a generic comparison report.
